findings.source_quote: “yield [our] members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin” ... “yield [ourself] unto God ... and our members as instruments of righteousness unto God”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the quoted clauses with: “atatoa [viungo vyake] viwe vyombo vya udhalimu kwa dhambi” ... “atajitoa [mwenyewe] kwa Mungu, kama aliye hai kutoka kwa wafu, na viungo vyake viwe vyombo vya haki kwa Mungu”. Preserve the existing reference “(Rum 6:13)”.
findings.translation_quote: “ataitoa miili [yake] iwe silaha za dhuluma kwa dhambi” ... “atajiweka [mwenyewe] kwa Mungu ... na viungo vyake viwe silaha za haki kwa Mungu”
